identity.title: Verify Recipe lifecycle journal process recovery

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and current-source reconciliation
origin.summary: 2D-022 asks for process-stop recovery at each Recipe Pipeline lifecycle journal stage. The same boundary already exists as the completed PL-0009/OVL-06a owner and process-boundary evidence.

state.current_summary: The existing VisionPipelineStorage lifecycle journal and OVL-06a parent/child process harness already satisfy 2D-022. Current lifecycle source has no diff after that evidence; apphost and dotnet DLL runs recovered all 11 stage cases without duplicate implementation or new runtime ownership.

objective.summary: Reconcile 2D-022 with the existing lifecycle journal process-boundary owner, preserve the evidence-based recovery contract, and advance without reopening PL-0009.
constraints: Reuse VisionPipelineStorage lifecycle journal, rollback/adoption logic, persistence states, and the existing process-recovery smoke harness; do not add a second journal or recovery service.
Use the existing isolated D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev evidence; do not modify user Recipes or C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not repeat implementation or process tests already protected as complete when the current lifecycle owner has no relevant source diff.
Do not commit, push, release, deploy, or perform external communication.

criteria.text: The current owner and call path show durable journal, backup, target, pointer, source, and recovery-state ownership with no competing lifecycle writer.

Existing apphost and dotnet process-boundary evidence covers six rename stages and five applicable delete stages, with 11/11 child kills and 11/11 valid prior/completed recoveries and no leftover journal/backup/tmp artifacts.
Stable contract, live handoff, issue ledger, and the active 5-minute automation record the completed boundary, unverified limits, and next 2D-023 handoff without reopening PL-0009.

context.location: VisionPipelineStorage.TryRenamePipeline/TryDeletePipeline owns the journal and file lifecycle; TryRecoverPendingLifecycleTransactionCore owns reopen rollback/adoption and LifecycleRecoveryRequired/LifecycleRecovered states; the smoke parent/child boundary owns only process-stop reproduction.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke parent -> child process probe -> durable lifecycle stage -> parent Kill(entireProcessTree) -> storage reopen -> prior-state rollback or proven completed-state adoption -> artifact and state assertions.

A process stop after a durable journal stage leaves exactly one valid prior or completed Pipeline state. Ambiguous foreign/invalid files yield LifecycleRecoveryRequired and remain available for operator review; no automatic Preview/Run or routing mutation occurs.

Durable journal-stage process stop and same-data-root reopen are verified for apphost and dotnet DLL launches. Power loss, filesystem corruption, non-cooperative native worker termination, full WPF state/theme/layout/DPI/input, hardware, release/publication, and Original repository remain unverified or out of scope.

artifacts.summary: Existing OVL-06a source/call-path, acceptance, process-boundary, verification, and limitation record.
Existing Release apphost and dotnet DLL process recovery evidence, same-process recovery, storage path, build, and diff checks.

evidence.observation: Current-source review confirms the lifecycle owner and process harness remain the existing PL-0009/OVL-06a path. The lifecycle implementation has no relevant worktree diff after the process-boundary evidence; only an unrelated schema-load guard is present in the storage diff.

Release apphost process-boundary contract passed 11/11 cases: six rename stages and five applicable delete stages, with Cases=11, Recovered=11, ChildLaunches=11, ChildKills=11, prior/completed state assertions, and zero remaining journal/backup/temporary files.
The dotnet DLL process-boundary contract also passed 11/11; the same-process PL-0009 lifecycle recovery and storage-path regressions passed in the same isolated evidence set.

The current stable contract, live handoff, issue record, and sole ACTIVE five-minute automation now map 2D-022 to the existing completed owner, preserve its limits, and advance the next ready boundary to 2D-023.

events.summary: Close 2D-022 by reconciling the existing PL-0009/OVL-06a process-boundary evidence with the current unchanged lifecycle owner; do not duplicate implementation or tests.
